title: Cashflow control 1:1 prep - scratchpad
content:
Context / goal:
- Prep notes for weekly 1:1 with Jon (finance lead) to triage short-term cashflow pressure, decide on a small set of procurement holds, and align next steps for Q2 run-rate cuts.
- Focus: preserve runway while minimizing customer impact for Dedicated and Private onboarding projects.

Quick summary (TL;DR):
- Net burn currently trending +3.1% vs prior 30d baseline after payroll and committed infra spikes. Biggest drivers: (1) Dedicated reserved GPU top-ups (one-time), (2) vendor invoices catching up (security integrations), (3) higher-than-expected data egress on a pilot customer.
- Action ask to Jon: authorize temporary procurement freeze for non-critical SaaS (marketing martech, bench analytics), escalate approval for two capital items that unblock Dedicated delivery.

Agenda (30 min):
1) 5m: Quick numbers check — run-rate snapshot + cash runway estimate.
2) 10m: Procurement triage — list of vendors to pause vs need-to-approve.
3) 10m: Customer-delivery blockers (Dedicated/Private) where spend prevents milestone completion. Decide which to prioritize.
4) 5m: Assign actions & timing.

Run-rate snapshot (rough figures) — notes to self, validate with ledger before call:
- Monthly baseline burn (Feb avg): $3.25M
- Recent month (Mar partial): $3.35M (+3.1%)
- Committed one-offs in queue: ~$260k (reserved GPU purchase + vendor back-invoices)
- Net runway (as of today): ~10.8 months (pre-commits), post-commits ~9.5 months — confirm CFO calc

Where the variance actually is (quick drilldown):
- Infrastructure: +$140k one-time (reserved GPUs queued for Dedicated cluster expansion)
- Vendor/integrations: +$65k (two invoices from security vendor deferred from Jan)
- Sales / PST: +$30k (customer egress overage for pilot customer ACME that agreed to reimburse later)
- Hiring / People: flat this month (recruiting paused for two IC roles)

Procurement triage list (suggested tags: Pause / Defer / Approve now):
- Pause: Marketing martech renewal (Mar 31 renewal) — can pause autosubscribe, push to Apr 30 for decision (saves ~$18k/yr pro-rated).
- Pause: Bench analytics annual tier upgrade (not blocking any ship) — $24k immediate saving if deferred.
- Defer: Office hardware refresh for new hires (can split into smaller batches) — ~$45k capex; propose defer to Q3.
- Approve-now: NVMe-backed reserved GPU nodes for Dedicated cluster (PR#GH-1123) — $180k one-time; unblock 2 pilot customers and avoid SLA penalty.
- Approve-now: Security vendor invoice FIN-INV-993 (deferred) — $65k; vendor holds critical audit logs for Private deployments.

Risks / tradeoffs to call out:
- Freezing marketing martech may affect PLG funnel tracking — coordinate with Growth so we can short-circuit a measured rollback if we see funnel drop.
- Deferring Bench analytics reduces internal dev velocity for infra team but not customer-facing.
- Holding NVMe purchase delays Dedicated capacity—risk of missing committed throughput SLAs for one customer if we delay more than 2 weeks; could cause credit / penalty exposure.

Customer blockers / delivery alignment:
- Customer: ApexBank (Private) — needs security connector integration that depends on vendor that we owe $65k (see above). If not approved, onboarding stalls, $30k ARR at risk in first quarter but more in renewal.
- Customer: SatoriHealth (Dedicated pilot) — throughput tests need NVMe nodes; agreed POC contract includes time-bound performance acceptance. Delay risks losing POC => revenue opportunity of ~$120k ARR in 6 months.

Questions for Jon in the 1:1:
- Are we comfortable moving the NVMe spend into capital with amortization across Q2 to reduce immediate cash hit? Who signs capex vs opex? (Flag Legal/corp accounting)
- For the vendor invoice, can we negotiate a 30-day net extension with a small fee instead of full immediate pay? If so, what's acceptable?
- Do we need an explicit executive-level exception process for purchases that unlock revenue (to speed approvals)?

Prep checklist (items I need before the call):
- Confirm ledger / AP status for FIN-INV-993 and attach invoice stub (ask AP: Maya).
- Updated run-rate model with committed orders toggled on/off (CFO spreadsheet link) — attach snapshot.
- NVMe procurement PR (GH-1123) summary + vendor quote + estimated delivery lead time.
- Basic customer impact matrix (ApexBank, SatoriHealth) with ARR at risk and SLA exposure.

Notes-to-self / talking phrases to use:
- "This is about preserving runway without blocking revenue — propose short list of immediate holds + two targeted approvals that unlock customer revenue."
- "We can convert the NVMe purchase to capex with CFO sign-off to smooth cash impact — willing to structure if that helps."
- "Marketing pause is reversible; plan a 1-week A/B test to check funnel impact if concerned."

Planned outcome (what I'm asking Jon to sign off on):
- Approve immediate payment of security vendor invoice (FIN-INV-993) OR negotiate 30-day extension with vendor fees capped at 2%.
- Approve NVMe reserved nodes purchase (PR#GH-1123) given revenue unlock and SLA risk; if not approved, authorize contingency runway to migrate customers to lower tier temporarily.
- Pause marketing martech autosubscribe and defer Bench analytics upgrade (formal freeze communicated to vendors by AP).

Follow-ups / action items (assign during call):
- Aisha: get AP to attach invoice and vendor contact for negotiation (due: today EOD).
- Jon: decide on NVMe capex vs opex treatment and advise Legal/Accounting (due: by Tue morning).
- Maya (AP): send hold notice to martech vendor and Bench analytics vendor pending approval (due: Fri).
- Sales Ops: draft customer communication plan for SatoriHealth in case we need to extend POC timeline (owner: TBD) — deliverable: 1-pager.

Random scratch calc (double-check later):
- If we defer $87k of discretionary commits this month (marketing + bench + office deferral), runway improves by ~0.85 months. If we also negotiate 30-day extension on $65k invoice, immediate cash relief of $65k but obligation in 30 days.

Other notes / follow-ups: 
- Flag: any approval that impacts Dedicated capacity should be looped into Eng Delivery sync to avoid misalignment.
- Add line item to next finance weekly: estimate impact of PLG funnel pause after 1 week (growth to provide signal).

End-of-doc quick checklist before saving a copy to shared drive: 
- Replace placeholders with actual PR/Invoice IDs and attach PDFs.
- Move final decision notes to Confluence page FIN/Cashflow-Model-2026 once approved.
- Upload signed PO to drive folder: shared_drives/company/finance-and-legal/purchase-orders (after approval).

-- scratchpad end --
